method: Streamed every records part and list part named in each groups file's raw block (all numbered continuation parts included); kept rows whose pn matched a group number (alnum-normalised exact match). Naming fields: records name, aux_desc, description, other_names (split on ';'), list_group, list_remark, list_notes, list_info (minus Location/Replaced By/Callout/Fitting/Production Date lines), evidence_lines 'Part Description:'; list rows main, aux, group, remark, extra (minus quantity/location/replaced-by/fitting-option/production-date). 'line' is the logical line number counted across parts (rawparts.py); 'line_in_part' is the line within the named part file. Kinds are my own reading; no curation code used.
